notes.title: 1.0 hotfixes and changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Changed dash behaviour so that when you're standing still, you will still dash.
[list]
[*] When using mouse/keyboard: in the direction of the mouse. 
[*] When using controller: in the direction of your last move direction. 
[*] When using controller and manual aiming: in the direction of your target. 
[/list]
[*] Fixed some spacing issues in Russian on the success/failure screen. 
[*] Fixed a problem where the nest spider would walk on the spot during buy phase. 
[*] Boss drops won't spawn out of bounds any more, they will be moved to the closest boundary. 
[*] Free rerolls will now stack when holding level ups. 
[*] Reduced SHR22 damage from 24 -> 18. 
[/list]

notes.title: UI Update 2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the DPS increase shown could be a NaN.
- Fixed an issue where Grid Support items were showing the DPS of previous weapons.

notes.title: Hotfix: UI Update 2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a problem where the grid capacity grid upgrade wasn't applying. 
- Changed info panel to get smaller when reducing a weapon (the button space wasn't being removed). 
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't move properly with WASD if a gamepad was plugged in and the stick would drift slightly.

notes.title: UI Update 2 & 1.0 Release date delay
notes.notes:
- New mech models to make it easier to recognize individual units, and what synergy they belong to. 
- New weapon models to help identify weapons more easily. 
- New end screen that shows units, weapons, damage, synergies and perks. 
- Info panel will now show stat increases that come from unit specials, perks and synergies. 
- Updated the look of the info panel. 
- Updated the look of the perk list. 
- Main menu tutorial pop ups.
- End screen shows total damage instead of DPS. 

Balance changes:
- Increased levels required per perk from 4->5. 

Bug fixes
- Fixed a problem where the grid capacity upgrade wasn't applying.
- Fixed an issue where highlight and tooltip wouldn't go away when selling with the controller shortcut.

We still have the Gameplay Update to complete, and in order to complete that in time we need to delay the 1.0 release date by 1 week. The new date for release is 25 October!

Let us know what you think, find any bugs, or have any suggestions! Have a great weekend!

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Announcement, and price increase.
notes.notes:
It has been an exhilarating experience to share and update the game with everyone over the last few months. Unfortunately, we haven't generated enough revenue to complete the roadmap of features we set out to release when we entered Early Access. We're sorry to disappoint anyone who was looking forward to any specific features we had planned. [b]Here is the updated roadmap, as always feel free to suggest anything or let us know what you think. [/b]

[h1]Updated roadmap[/h1]

[h2]Upcoming updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller update (next update).
[*] UI Update 2 (following update).
[list]
 [*] 	More detailed end screen.
 [*] 	New mech models.
[*] 	New shop models.
[*] 	Show synergy/special bonuses in unit/weapon info.
[*] 	New tutorial, and more prompts in the main menu.
[/list]
[*] Gameplay update (final big update)
[list]
[*] More boss moves.
[*] Environmental explosives.
[*] Movement changes (Manual aiming, dash).
[*] New boss.
[/list]
[*] Bug fixes & balancing.
[/list]


[h2]Cancelled updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corporate contracts.
[*] Deck management.
[*] Compendium.
[*] Statistics.
[*] New maps.
[/list]

We will continue to bug fix, and balance the game after release.
[h3]
The final price of the game will be 5.99$ / 5.99€, starting October 5.
[/h3]
[h3]The release date for 1.0 is the 17th of October.[/h3]

notes.title: PERKS UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h2]Perks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grid Upgrade Trees have been split out, and are now perks.
[*] There is no longer a choice when choosing a perk, you can only upgrade it.
[*] Increased perk choices from 4->5.
[*] Receive a perk every 4 levels.
[/list]
[h2]Nests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nest bosses no longer drop perks.
[*] Nest bosses now drop a supply drop.
[*] A supply drop rolls 4 choices of random mechs or weapons, each choice has a chance to be a:
	[list]
[*]    Mech upgrade (30%)
[*] 	Weapon upgrade (30%)
[*] 	Mech synergy upgrade (20%)
[*] 	Weapon synergy upgrade (20%)
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]New weapon[/h2]
A new Harvest Guild Arms weapon has been added: The Extractor.
[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] All level 1 perks now increase existing stats, instead of adding. 
[*] Weapons buffed: Oil Trap, Creeping Scythes, and The Eye.
[*] Weapons nerfed: Naga Chaingun, Chaos Emitter, Apocco Launcher, Doomwheel, Oscillator Rifle, and Obliteration Ray.
Mech nerfed: Royal Harvester.
[/list]
[h2]UI updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ordnance now shows a timer for team buffs.
[*] Payment screens, damage leaderboard have an updated look.
[*] New battery indicator to show when players will receive a perk. 
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: - Fixed a problem when entering battle phase, where your grid would become misaligned.

notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Graphics[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved the look and feel of lighting.
[*] Added high quality shadows to all enemies.
[*] Adjusted synthtech and bullets to suit the new lighting.
[*] Mechs now have 'casting' FX when using synthtech.
[*] Mechs now leave dust where their feet hit the ground (with a sound effect).
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] In the buy phase the grid expands. This should help with drag/dropping and seeing your units and weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: Cloud Saving Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Cloud saving[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The first steam login you use will take the 'old save' that was incompatible with cloud saving. 
[*] Multiple logins on the same machine or windows profile can now have a separate save. 
[*] If you have any problems with your save, or cloud saving let me know on Discord or on the Battle Grid Steam discussions.
[/list]

[h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Show max gold tooltip when you hover over your ZAR.
[*] Improved visibility of planet selection buttons. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera shake setting wasn't reflecting properly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where audio settings weren't applied on startup. 
[*] Fixed Pop Rox weapon position.
[/list]

[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[b]UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] Gunslingers: piercing reduced from [2/3/4] to [1/2/4], Reload Reduction reduced from [20%/30%/40%] to [10%/20%/40%].
[/list]

[b]WEAPONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Rusty Rifle: Range reduced from 25 to 20.
[*] Atomic Crossbow: base crit chance reduced from 5% to 3%.
[*] Auto Shotgun Fire: Fire rate reduced from 2 to 1.5 bullets per second, Base Damage reduced 8-12 to 6.5.
[*] SR Photon Launcher: Fire rate increased from 4 to 5 bps, Base damage increased from 34-37.
[*] Heavy SMG: Base Damage increased from 13-20 to 22.
[*] Tachyon Rifle:  Reload time increased from 3.7s to 4s, range Reduced from 25 to 20, base crit chance reduced from 5% to 3%, Knockback reduced from 15 to 10.
[*] Eternity Machine Gun: Fire Rate reduced from 12.2 to 10, base damage reduced from 15-13.
[*] Uber Launcher: Base Damage increased from 30 to 101.
[*] Super Shotgun: Base Damage reduced from 8 to 6.5.
[*] Crossfire Rifle: Clip Size Reduced from 20 to 10, Reload Time increased from 2s to 4s, bullets fired per burst reduced from 5 to 2, Fire Rate Reduced from 5 to 2, Base Damage increased from 11-20 to 56.
[*] The Twins Synergy: Range is increased by 100%.
[/list]

[b]ENEMIES[/b]
[list]
[*] Both world minor changes to the spawn rates for the last 40 seconds so powerful players won't run out of things to kill near the end of runs.
[*] The Beast and Father Bossfights have been swapped.
[/list]

notes.title: UI Update 1
notes.notes:
UI Features:
- Added auto upgrade for Units when purchasing from the shop. 
- Added right-click for instant upgrade of Weapons on the Grid. 

Graphics: 
- Changed the emissions of all bullets so that you can see more easily when doing end game bullet builds. 

Game Balance:
- Reduced damage of poison from 30 -> 15 per instance. 
- Increased health of nest concubine from 1000 -> 10 000.
- Bug shot bullets per round decreased from +50% -> +20%.

- Fixed an issue where you could get two tier 3 mercenaries and soft brick your run. 
- Fixed an issue where the shop would highlight a mech you already had a tier 3 version of.

notes.title: Battle Grid Demo Update
notes.notes:
Over the last two months we've released:
[list]
[*] The environment update: adds nests which you can find around the map. 
[*] The synthtech update: a complete overhaul of synthtech, which adds a new synergy and changes the way traps work. 
[*] More damage feedback: Enemies bleed, mechs explode on death, and mechs flash when they take damage. 
[*] Reskinned mechs: A higher variety of colours so you can more easily see different mechs in each unit synergy. 
[*] Loads of bug fixes and quality of life additions. 
[/list]

Check out announcements in our [url=https://discord.gg/weR96Sy8Jr]discord [/url]for more details on the updates!
